functional_correctness.description: The solution meets all the specified functional requirements without errors.

bug_sensitivity.description: The extent to which the solution can handle edge cases or subtle bugs introduced during modification.

engineering_quality.description: Overall quality of the code in terms of best practices, efficiency, and maintainability.

efficiency.description: The solution's performance in terms of time and space complexity, especially for large inputs.

robustness.description: The ability of the solution to handle unexpected inputs or errors gracefully.

api_library_usage.description: Appropriate use of APIs and libraries; whether the solution adheres to standard practices.

readability.description: Clarity and comprehensibility of the code, including naming conventions and comments.

maintainability.description: How easy it is to modify the code in the future, considering structure and documentation.

error_handling.description: The effectiveness of error handling mechanisms in the solution to prevent crashes.
